title: SubVive
description: Hey We Are An Nice And Official Minecraft Server Network Named SubVive
body:
🌍SubVive Network!
Welcome to our Network! We offer a diverse range of gamemodes designed to suit every playstyle. Whether you're a strategic conqueror, a master builder, or a PvP enthusiast, you'll find your place here.

🎮 Current Gamemodes:
ShardSMP (Survival Multiplayer): Classic survival experience with a focus on community and exploration.

Skyblock: Start on a tiny island with nothing but a tree and a bucket. Expand your floating fortress and master the server economy!

⏳ Coming Soon:
We are constantly evolving! The following modes are currently under development:

KingdomSMP: Immerse yourself in a world of factions! Build your kingdom, forge powerful alliances, and battle for total dominance.

SoupSMP: Fast-paced, skill-based PvP featuring the classic soup-healing mechanic.

Citybuild: Claim your plot, build your dream estate, and trade your way to the top.

Practice: Sharpen your combat skills in various arena modes to prepare for the real fight.

🚀 Why Join Us?
High Performance: Optimized servers for a smooth, lag-free experience.

Unique Features: Custom-tailored systems for every gamemode.

Growing Community: A dedicated staff team and a welcoming player base.

Join our journey today and help us build something legendary!
